facts.raw_span: A 76-year-old woman presented with macular edema
The patient was treated with 2 intravitreal anti–vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) injections
At 3 months after presentation, her macular edema was completely resolved, without recurrence
No specific physical examination findings were reported in the case
At 6 months: No abnormality observed
At 12 months: En face OCT revealed hyperreflective tissues starting to proliferate on retinal vessels
At 12 months: OCTA B-scan showed pyramid-shaped proliferations
At 15 months: Hyperreflective tissues increased in size with angiogenic sprouts showing flow signals extending vertically
At 18 months: Development observed in area of preexisting proliferation
At 21 months: Enlarged horizontal structures along retina surface
Performed at 21 months showing dendritic vascular-like structures
Figure 1: Sequential development over 1 year showing progression from normal vessels to proliferation
